summary: This Form 6-K filed by KT Corporation reports a routine board resolution setting a record date for a quarterly cash dividend. The record date is May 27, 2026, to determine shareholders entitled to the quarterly dividend. The board resolution was passed on May 12, 2026. This is a standard administrative dividend action under Article 49-2 of the company's articles of incorporation, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, premium, or strategic changes.
